messages.content: Describe a small disagreement with someone who trained you.

I had been helping with a repair and found a tool I had left back where I had been working. I went back to my work. My teacher asked why I had interrupted him. I answered that I had found the tool. He said I had interrupted him to get the tool. I had needed the tool and then gone back to my work. He was disappointed that I hadn't told him that
Would that person remember it the same way now?
I can't honestly answer that. It was an argument in the past.
